balls.text: he misses his length off the last ball and Bravo smokes that over long-on! That is a monster hit! Length at middle and off, front leg out of the way and a massive swing across the angle. Right off the middle
full and just outside off, steps out and slices that to sweeper's right

run-out at the non-striker's now. Full ball tails away from the bat, which is in the corridor, trying to swish it behind point. Thakur wants to steal the run after Bravo's beaten, but Bravo hasn't even had a thought about that. The bowler takes the throw on the bounce and runs him out

we might have a run-out at the striker's end here. Bravo loses the bat as he looks to pound it into the leg side. But his foot has landed! Looked to smoke this full ball away, got it high in the sky and it landed safely in front of long-off.
yorker at middle stump, jammed to deep midwicket. Whose throw is a direct hit that deflects into the off side and gives them an extra run
yorker outside off, jammed to extra cover's right. But the siren's gone off!

nails the yorker and then runs Curran out. Yorker at leg stump, jabbed it into the leg side. The batters hesitate on the second run and Mustafizur has done nicely to throw this back on the bounce to the keeper, from the edge of the circle at midwicket. Curran might have finished the run without that hesitation
yorker at off stump, looks to stab through the covers but it rolls back to Morris who flings the ball at the keeper in frustration
short of a length slower ball and down leg side, can't get bat on it
short and down leg side, left alone

Sakariya dives too early at point and that runs past him. Yorker at off stump, opens the face and carves this one-handed. Sakariya went in early so he was bouncing off the floor despite making the ground to cover it. And then Mustafiz can't chase fast enough from short third. Morris unhappy with that
vintage Bravo! Full slower ball outside off, dropping nicely into the slot and he springs into this, leaning backwards, going inside-out over extra cover. A proper throwback
edge as he looks to pull. Pretty obvious sound on that and Royals almost forgot to appeal. Short and across the corridor, looks to drag that into the leg side but that's quick

flies over short third! He was brought in for this ball, and he has to retrieve it now. Length ball across off stump, clears the front leg and looks to send this over midwicket. The edge gets him four
full and wide outside off, reaches out and slashes, but the outside edge won't beat Unadkat at third man
full slower ball wide outside off, looks to drill that through the covers. Inside edge to short fine
short of a length and up at the hips on leg stump. Jabbed into vacant midwicket
oh that is unreal! He's somehow managed to slap a slower short ball with incredible pace, over the point boundary! Ridiculous from Curran
length and into leg stump, pushes it to deep square's right with soft hands

taken at extra cover! Sakariya is ecstatic at outfoxing Dhoni. This is an offcutter at a length outside off, Dhoni wants to belt that out of orbit in the leg side. Goes very hard at it, ends up slicing, with one hand coming off the handle. Easy take for Buttler
gets it past extra cover and that is enough to beat long-off's big slide to the left as well. Full slower ball, brings the axe down on it and beats the infielder
slower short ball rising into the body. Mistimed pull to long-on
yorker just outside off, jammed past the stumps at the other end and far enough to Miller's left at long-on for them to get the second
swished behind square. Length ball into the body, swivels the upper body and drags this to the long leg boundary
beaten. Slower ball dug in short and moving away from off stump. Jadeja steps out and can't get the cut away. But it drops awkwardly for the keeper and they sneak a run on the deflection
slapped aerially past the bowler's knee. Short of a length ball outside off, went with hard hands and didn't get the timing on it
short at the ribs, leaps off the ground and whips to deep square
short of a length cutter, sticks in the pitch, gets big and rises past his attempted cut shot
full and into off stump, leans in and flicks to deep midwicket

just evades the bowler. Full slower ball at leg stump. Feet rooted and pushes in front of his body to try and get this down to long-on. Chips it back and it's a despairing dive, full stretch, backwards and to his right. Can't get a finger on it
slower ball at a length on middle stump, deep in the crease and defends into the pitch
full slower ball outside off, reaches out and drives to sweeper's right to steal another second
leading edge to point's right and it's slow enough that both him and the sweeper running in are caught in a tangle. Length ball at middle stump, looked to work it into the leg side
good length and into leg stump, gets deep in the crease and clips to deep square
short of a length slider outside off, looks to get forward and adjusts. Punched to extra cover
good length and in at off stump, reaches out and stabs it back to the bowler
full at off stump, steps out and pushes it down the pitch to the bowler

mix-up and Dhoni has had to dive. A run-out chance from short extra.He has just made it. Jabbed that slider into the covers and took off, was sent back immediately. Decent throw and the bails were off quick, but the dive saves him
short of a length slider outside off, reaches out and chops to sweeper
full slower ball at middle stump, dipping on Dhoni. Watchfully defended on the front foot
driven straight to mid-off! Overpitched ball at off stump, there for the taking. But he's punched it waist height to Morris. Very tentative tonight, Raina

slower ball at a length, following him down leg side again. Cramps him and he cops this on the thigh trying to shovel it fine. Then nearly caught out by Sanju as he's late in plonking his bat in the crease. Sanju misses the stumps
short and following him down leg. Makes room to try and play the upper cut, misses
full at middle stump, nice drive along the floor to long-on

taken at sweeper cover. Third catch for Parag. Short of a length just outside off, the trademark Rayudu slap on the rise. Aerial and decently connected. But taken just at the line, with a reverse cup above his head
slower short ball down leg side, beaten on the pull
neatly punched. Length ball just outside off, leans in and pats it on the rise to sweeper's right. Wants the second but Raina not keen. They get it anyway as Sakariya fails to gather the throw
top edge flies past short third. Short and pushed across off stump, clears the front leg and hoicks across the line. That got too big on him
short of a length at off stump, steps out and punches to long-off
short of a length and into the body, scrambles into the leg side and whipped to deep midwicket
short of a length at off stump, opens the face and runs it to third man
short of a length at off stump, defended off the back foot
good length and slanted in at leg stump, backs away and swishes at it. Thick inside edge to deep midwicket
short and wide outside off, cut straight to cover point

swung over the bowler! This is a brilliant counterattacking innings from Rayudu. This is dipping, length ball wide outside off. Gets down on one knee and hauls this against the turn. Flat and into the sightscreen
punishes this short ball. Very short, at a middle stump line, and he's in position quickly to dismiss this over the midwicket region
short of a length and sliding across off stump, punched aerially towards long-off
length and wide outside off, perhaps anticipating Rayudu coming down the track. He plants the front leg out and drives on the up to long-off
short of a length at off stump, punched into the stumps at the other end off the back foot
clubbed over midwicket! Raina steps up a gear, was always coming against spin. Length ball into middle stump from around the wicket - uses the angle to clear the fielder
length at off stump, a check drive, aerially to long-off's right. Another side-arm delivery and they're checking for the height of the arm. It is okay again
length outside off, lofted drive towards sweeper, mistimed

brings out the slinger but that pitches at a length outside off and deflects away, past the wide marker. Rayudu might have been in trouble if he'd stepped out, but he's just let that go. Umpire checks on the height of Parag's hand, and it is okay
length outside off, punched to extra cover on the up
crunches that in the sightscreen's direction. It's a joy yo watch Rayudu stepping out against spin. This is a legcutter, pushed through quickly at off stump. Steps out and so clean with this swing
full at off stump, driven straight back to the bowler
short of a length slider outside off, cut to sweeper's right
length at off stump, steps out and lifts this inside-out to sweeper's right
good length on off stump, defended back to the bowler
length ball pushed just outside off, a legbreak. Watchfully driven to long-off

dragged it straight to deep midwicket! Tewatia drops it short at middle stump, it's the one coming out the back of the hand, intended to spin away. Moeen drags it from off stump but can't connect to clear. An easy take for Parag, well inside the boundary
short of a length at off stump, punched to deep extra cover
low full toss at middle stump, mistimed slog trickles out to deep midwicket and that is Raina's first run of the night
attempted yorker at middle stump, Raina steps out and makes it a full toss. Can't manage to stab it past extra cover, the bowler fields on the bounce
full on middle stump, driven down to long-on
short ball, too short and rising steeply outside off. Left alone
past the keeper off the thigh and short third can't chase that. Short of a length and rising in at off stump, brings out the pull and misses on the under-edge
short of a length and rising outside off. Looks to punch through point, gets a thick outside edge to short third's left. Via a fingertip from the diving backward point. Unadkat retrieves with a slide
slower ball, short of a length outside off, slapped on the up to sweeper's left
yorker length outside off, watcfhully jammed into the covers
yorker at off stump and a nervous little push from Raina to keep this out. Those feet aren't moving right now
short and just outside off, chopped powerfully to sweeper cover
full and just outside off, nice flowing drive along the floor to mid-off

sweet, sweet hitting. Moeen's nailed the timing so far. This is short of a length and just outside off. Gets into his forward press and connects beautifully on the lofted pull. Flat but over deep midwicket
pulls out of the shot as he realises it's a slower ball. Good length and going wide outside off. Lands short of Sanju but they won't take the run as it deflects into the leg side
good length outside off, feet rooted to the crease as he punches to extra cover
has him ducking first ball. Just a tad too short though and it is called wide. That flew away outside off, Raina wasn't close
yorker length just outside off, sliced to sweeper cover
oh yes! A satisfying destruction of this length ball. Old-fashioned, full-blooded slog. Length ball turning in from outside off and he picks it and stands so still as he dispatches this
good length at off stump, defended down the pitch
length outside off, swishes on the rise and gets a thick edge fine of short third
short of a length just outside off, defended off the back foot
short of a length and very wide outside off, left alone
short of a length at off stump, dabbed into the off side with soft hands
good length and just outside off, looks to drive on the initial angle but that straightens marginally to go past the inside edge

taken at deep point! Short of a length and pushed wide outside off. Faf steps out again and is forced to reach out. Can only manage a slice at that and it's a simple catch in the deep. Faf's done his job in the powerplay
check pull but can't beat short fine. Slower short ball and he watches it closely before pulling into the ground. Unadkat dives to the left to stop
short of a length just outside off, punched to mid-off on the up
good length and across off stump, flowing drive on the rise to extra cover

lofted straight over the bowler. Caps it all off by picking up four more. Unadkat's plans have been completely thrown out. This is an offcutter at length on off stump, he waits under it and offers the full face before jabbing at it. Lands just short of the boundary padding

sliced over the long-off boundary! Superb stuff from Faf this over. Expert maneuvering of the field. Got fine leg pushed back, so the two men back are both on the leg side. That allows him to step out and access the off side without fear. And he steps out to this short of a length slower ball across off and swings through it on the up

low full toss swung away from the corridor, steps out and has a hack at that but it comes off the inside edge, back to the bowler. Immediately signals for a change in gloves, looks like the bat slipped when he made connection
and again! On the floor once more to pick up four. Good length and across off stump again, this time at regular pace. Falls into the off side and scoops it over short fine
oh clever. It's a slower length ball, down at 108kph, outside off. Faf drops into the off side, right knee down, and scoops this between keeper and short fine
good length and jagging in from outside off. Moeen fends it into the midwicket region off the thick inside edge
outside edge as Faf looks to drive a cutter on the up. Rolls out to short third. Nice grip on this length ball outside off

taken at mid-off. It's been a three-bowler effort to build this pressure and Mustafizur ends up getting Gaikwad's wicket. Short of a length slower ball cutting away from off stump. Walks down at it and wants to pull over mid-on, ends up slicing it high for the fielder
hesitation with the running again, but safely in at the striker's end. Slower ball at a length on off stump,Faf drops it in front of point and Ruturaj stops before taking off again
survives a run-out chance at the non-striker's end. Full slower ball at middle and leg, walks down at that and pats that straight to Morris at mid-on. Made his ground it appears, no direct hit
sails over the stumps. Good length, swung back in again. Steps out and looks to whip it into the leg side but it's underneath his bat
starts with an inswinger and an lbw appeal. Full and in from a middle stump line, but that got an inside edge onto Faf's front pad as he looked to flick
short of a length at leg stump, nudged to short fine's left
another step-out-and-swat. Unadkat is slamming them in at a length so this is Faf sizing him up. It's short of a length and across the corridor, and he meets it with a pull to midwicket
offcutter at a length on middle stump, leans in as he flicks to mid-on
good length at off stump, defended to point off the back foot
length at the stumps, deep in the crease to clip this to deep square
short of a length and just outside off, punched to sweeper point off the back foot

swats it over long-on! Pre-meditation as he jumps down the track. But then he adjusts well for this slower ball outside off. Meets it at the pitch, a bit away from his body, but swings nicely to drag it into the leg side
short and just outside off, cut firmly out to sweeper cover
good length at off stump, walks down at it and cramps himself. Defended down the pitch
beaten. Good length and across off stump. Drives for the one coming in
good length and pushed across off stump, driven on the up to sweeper cover
good length ball curving in at leg stump, watchfully pushed through vacant midwicket
good length just outside off, leans in and punches that straight to extra cover
good length at off stump, gets forward and defends close to the body
jags in off the seam. Good length ball pitching at middle stump and cramping Faf who was searching for the one going across
short of a length just outside off, neat punch past extra cover and sweeper point has a lot of distance to cover
good length and just outside off, opens the face and runs that to short third

Tewatia strecthes to the right at slip and can only get fingers on this! Gaikwad chases the length ball slanted across off stump, gets an edge first up. A difficult catch is dropped. And it trickles past short third
bouncer at middle stump, ducks to let it go
short of a length on middle stump, defended off the back foot
short one at middle stump, looks to hook and is beaten
short of a length at middle stump, slammed on the thigh guard as he looks to defend

picks out Jadeja at sweeper! He holds up four fingers to his team-mates! At least he's keeping count, because I've lost it. Full and wide ball outside off, reaches out and slices it. Jadeja with some strides to the left and a nice little leap to hold it
full and very wide outside off, can't get bat on it after reaching out
full and very wide outside off, can't reach with a stretch
full and wide outside off, chucks his hands at that, thick edge flies over short third
carved to extra cover. Yorker outside off, looks to pounce on this. Hard hands. Loses his shape and it's a simple catch
full slower ball outside off, gets down for the scoop, ends up cue ending it to the bowler
smoked! Short of a length at off stump, no nuance, just a slap across the line and sends it over deep midwicket

Gowtham takes the catch at deep midwicket and then steps over the boundary. Full toss outside off, swung into the leg side. The sub fielder takes that neatly, but his landing step is over the padding. Can only mean he wasn't aware where he was, there was no attempt to lob that back in
full slower ball outside off, lofted drive comes off the toe-end and just clears extra cover
dipping yorker at off stump, Unadkat puts on a little dance to try and distract Bravo as he's running in. But he's forced to poke this into the covers
full and just outside off, mistimed drive down to long-on
length on the pads, waits on it and shovels that between short fine and square leg
slower short ball at middle stump, pulled to deep midwicket's left
low full toss just outside off, beaten on the drive. Dhoni doesn't gather cleanly

shuffles and drags this over the fine leg boundary. Proactive, and well executed. Short of a length and across off stump, a slower ball. Quick feet to jump into the line of that and a swivel to lift it
yorker length and wide outside off, beaten on the slash
length outside off, slogs with the turn to deep midwicket's left and there is Jadeja again to stop it
short of a length at the stumps, jabbed off the back foot

a wild Jadeja appears out of nowhere. Ridiculous. Short of a length ball at off, gets nice bat on the reverse swat over backward point. Jadeja sprints to his right, casually sticks out a right hand and stops that on the bounce. Manages to stop immediately too. Some suspension system in there...
length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
length at middle stump, looks to sweep, gets a top edge into the midwicket region
nearly bounces onto the stumps. Looks for the reverse sweep, gets his body and drops in front of the stumps. He stops it with the bat
slower ball at a length outside off, gets forward and is beaten on the attempted drive
low full toss at off stump, driven to sweeper's right
full at off stump, clears the front leg and drills to sweeper's right
full at leg stump, looks to slog and cops that on the pad
short of a length slower ball at off stump, stabbed to point's right
full and wide outside off, reaches out to chop, beaten
offcutter, back of a length and just outside off. Opens the face and slides this to short third
full at off stump, poked into the covers and takes off for the single. Send back
full at off stump, poked into the covers off the front foot
good length outside off, leans in and jabs to short third's right

this is a proper capitulation! Morris picks out deep midwicket. He said after the last match that there are those paid to bat, and those paid to slog and he knew he was the latter. Might question that after this. Length ball outside off, goes with the turn, a slog sweep, but that is taken further inside than the one of Parag two balls ago
full and just outside off, looks for the reverse sweep first up. Struck on that pad but outside off stump

slog sweep finds deep midwicket! Offbreak at a length outside off, gets low and swings at that. He's been looking for a release shot. But that's the long side of the ground and it's taken a couple of yards inside by Jadeja
length and sliding onto the stumps, pushed into the leg side off the thick inside edge
length at off stump, stops in his tracks as he looks to punch this
short of a length at off stump, punched straight to extra cover
length at off stump, punched to long-on off the front foot
good length outside off, blocked on the front foot
good length and sliding on outside off, driven to long-off's left
appeal for lbw again as this one slides on and catches the pad in front of leg stump. He was looking to flick that

given out lbw as he sweeps and he's walking right off! That turned away a lot, he might have been saved if he'd reviewed this. Length ball pitching at off, he shuffled slightly for the sweep and copped that on the pad as it turned away. Just in front of off stump/the corridor. We'll have to see the replay, Miller didn't even discuss it with his partner
length and turning in from outside off, gets back and defends off the outside edge to short third
full and just outside off, leans in and flicks to midwicket
length and skidding on at leg stump, looks to flick and cops it on the pad
length at the stumps, pushed pitch side off the front foot

that looks plumb. Dube doesn't review it. Just in time. Short of a length outside off, ripping back in and he's missed the line and plays a hurried swish at this. Beaten on the inside edge. Caught on the knee roll, in front of off stump. There's no bat on it. Impact is umpire's call and that is hitting the top of the stumps. Dube's innings dies like it lived - meek
short and quick outside off, shuffles and miscues a pull to deep backward square
short of a length outside off, waits on that to turn in and opens the face to run it to short third's right
short of a length and turning a long way in at middle stump, punched back down the pitch
short of a length at middle stump, punched past midwicket off the back foot

squares him up with a beauty! We saw a glimpse of grip and turn during his last over, but that was a very wide ball. This one pitches leg stump, has Buttler deep in the crease and looking to close the face as it rips rapidly past the bat and splits middle and off. A dream dismissal for a left-arm spinner, beautifully executed
yorker just outside off, jammed back to the bowler on the bounce
high full toss, very very wide outside off. Beaten on the chop
yorker, wide outside off, shuffles and has a chop at it. Beaten and it is called wide
low full toss at middle stump, flicked to deep midwicket
full dipping slower ball at off stump, driven straight to extra cover
low full toss outside off, driven off the toe-end to sweeper
full slower ball wide outside off, reaches out to drive to extra cover's left
full and very wide, left alone, not called a wide this time and Dube's wondering why
full and very wide again, left alone
full and very very wide, left alone
short of a length outside off, under-edge on the cut, to short third
full and sliding into the stumps, clears the front leg and has a slog. Thick inside edge to deep square

slotted over deep midwicket and he hears the siren as well! Jadeja has overstepped. Dropped this one short and he waited on the back foot to pull this. Dhoni said "na" immediately. That was before the no-ball call
full and dipping outside off, thick outside edge to short third as he looks to drive
inside edge as he shapes for the reverse sweep. Quick and at leg stump, was cramped
dropped short at middle stump but he can't get any power on this pull. Out to deep square
short of a length and turning away from off stump, pushed to point's right
elegant! This is overpitched at off stump, he holds his shape and lofts this over his partner at the other end
full and just outside off, check-drive along the floor to mid-off
short of a length at leg stump, clipped to midwicket's left
length at the stumps, jabbed to extra cover from the crease
full and down leg side, catches the pad as he looks to flick
thundered over point. Short and wide and he slaps this viciously, no attempt to keep it down
length at middle stump, clips it to Rayudu's left at midwicket and hesitates. But Buttler had made up his mind to run through
length outside off, gets forward and pushes through cover with soft hands
short of a length and gripping in the surface, jabbed to point
powered through point with another reverse sweep. Fuller, flatter, tighter at the stumps. No matter - sends that racing to sweeper's left
length and turning away outside off, gets into position and gets a reverse swat past backward point
short of a length and turning into leg stump, nudged through midwicket off the back foot
short and just outside off, steers it to third man with an angled bat
full and very wide outside off, reaches out and drives to sweeper cover
full on leg stump, leans in and flicks to mid-on's left
full and just outside off, a neatly timed drive, straight to mid-off
length at leg stump, clipped through midwicket
starts with a yorker, at middle and off. Squeezed towards point
short and up at the ribs, defended off the back foot
drags it to mid-on! The slower ball does it. Short of a length and just outside off. Looks for the lofted pull, can't time it because off the revs on it. Ends up slicing it straight to Bravo
full slower ball at off stump, defended into the covers
short outside off, mistimed pull to deep square's left
short and wide outside off, another slice, and this time he finds short third
short of a length just outside off, chopped to backward point's left
short of a length at off stump, sweetly timed punch but straight to mid-off. Annoyed with himself
full on leg stump, leans in and flicks to fine leg's left
short at middle stump, quickly rises past his attempted hook
beaten on the drive. Full and just outside off, he plays inside the line of this

launched straight! That is the trademark Buttler golf-swing. A knuckle ball at length, just outside off. He waits on it and it looks so magical, almost like he's got the ball to stop so he can swing cleanly through it. All balance, beautiful
full and at middle stump, slower ball. Buttler doesn't move the feet too much but he meets this at the pitch and lofts it over the non-striker
short of a length and down leg side, past the attempted glance
full and wide outside off, left alone

pulls straight to the fielder who was just placed there! Oh boy. He's shaking his head, probably a mixture of anger and embarrassment. Short ball at the body again, another good looking pull. Not timed as well as the previous one. Jadeja had just been placed there and he jogs in to take a simple one

oh there's some class to this. Picturesque from Vohra as he pulls this. Short of a length and just outside off, adjusts his feet very quickly and gets his weight forward and into this ball. Over the midwicket boundary
short of a length at middle and leg, shuffles and catches that on the thigh as he looks for the glance
length at off stump, jabbed to point's right with soft hands
short of a length and kicking up at an off stump line, beaten on the outside edge as he hangs the bat out
short of a length at leg stump, clipped to deep square's left
short of a length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot but he meets a diving Jadeja to the left at cover
oh nicely adjusted. Short slower ball, at off stump. He shaped for the pull but had to adjust for the slow pace. Stretched his hands out and calibrated to get this off the middle
short of a length and just outside off, sliced to backward point
overpitched and wide outside off, leans in and drives to sweeper point along the floor
slower ball at a length, just outside off. Looks  to jab into the off side, gets an inside edge through square leg
short of a length and cutting past the outside edge as he looks to get behind that and work it square in the off side
short of a length and just outside off, chopped to point's left
full and wide outside off, chases for the drive and is beaten

dropped at short third. Quite literally a short third on this occasion, but Thakur does brilliantly to even get a hand on this. It's a full offcutter wide outside off and Buttler has just chucked his arms at this, feeling for it. Thick edge, loopy over Thakur and it's a decently timed jump. But can't get fingers around the ball
length outside off, patted into the covers
slower ball at a length on off stump, defended into the off side
short of a length and just outside off, steered to short third
sweet timing. Short of a length and just outside off, uses his forward press to spring back and steer this past point with a punch
full and straight on at off stump, rooted to the crease as he flicks this to square leg
short of a length and just outside off, punched to cover's right and he stops with a dive
full and into leg stump, flicked to fine leg's left
ah, beautiful. Full ball at off stump, half a stride and the full face offered to punch it past the non-striker
